about: ClimbingRecs starter catalog (2026-10-24): current climbing shoes, harnesses, belay devices, dynamic ropes, chalk bags and bouldering crash pads. Every value was read on 2026-10-24 from the maker's own product page linked in sources (Scarpa, Black Diamond, Mad Rock, Butora, So iLL, Evolv, Organic, Beal, Edelrid, Petzl); anything not stated there is blank. Not in it yet: La Sportiva, Five Ten (adidas) and Moon (their sites refused to be read) and Unparallel (site unreachable); Tenaya, Ocun, Wild Country, Mammut, Sterling, DMM and CAMP were not read in this pass. One entry per model as the maker names it: sizes, lengths, colours, men's and women's cuts and dry treatments sold under one model name are one entry (Black Diamond Momentum men's/women's, Beal Joker 9.1 mm Dry Cover or Golden Dry, Organic Big Pad 4 in or 5 in), but a different model, version or volume is not (Scarpa Instinct VS vs VSR vs VSR LV, Evolv Shaman vs Shaman 2S vs Shaman Pro, Mad Rock Drone 2 vs Drone CS vs D2.ONE, HV vs LV, Petzl GRIGRI vs GRIGRI +, Black Diamond 9.4 Dry vs 9.4 Non-Dry). Left out: kids' and rental shoes, past-season items, Evolv's 2026 Zenist and V6 (named only by year next to an older model of the same name), Mad Rock's 2026 pads (same), work and rescue gear. Columns: shape = category, balance = type (closure for shoes as the page states it: Strap, Lace or Slipper; rope type; belay device type; harness use; chalk bag or bucket; pad kind), surface = key specs (rubber, rope range, diameter and g/m, open size), core = main material or treatment, weight = weight as the page states it (shoes: one shoe in the stated size where the page says so). No model years.
